title: Puke
summary: PUKE, verb intransitive [Heb. to evacuate, to empty; Latin vacuo; to burst forth; Latin spuo, for spuco, with a prefix. The radical sense is to throw or drive.] To vomit; to eject from the stomach. PU

inlines.v: PUKE, verb intransitive [Heb. to evacuate, to empty; Latin vacuo; to burst forth; Latin spuo, for spuco, with a prefix. The radical sense is to throw or drive.] To vomit; to eject from the stomach. PUKE, noun A vomit; a medicine which excites vomiting. PUKE, adjective Of a color between black and russet.
